I want to create a reel script according to my brand voice that should go viral on the topic that
You can see everybody on the internet, building Al automations and Al agents for them and
using it, but nobody tells you how to build one. You would probably be thinking that all of these
are paid ones, so it's out of your reach. At a point, main bhi yahi socha karta tha. But I have
built an automation with five different Al agents that completely automates my content
system. The entire automation works like this. Let me give you the context of it. :
Content Agent OS - Al-Powered Instagram Growth Automation
A fully automated content intelligence system for Instagram creators. Every day at 7:30 AM, it:
1. Scrapes the last 20 posts from the creator's account + 10 competitors via Apify
2. Transcribes competitor reels using Gemini Files API - extracting spoken scripts, hooks, and
patterns
3. Fetches global trends from YouTube, HackerNews, and Google Trends filtered for the
creator's niche
4. Runs 4 Al agents via Gemini API:
- Ideator - generates 50 content ideas using competitor data, transcripts, trends, hook bank,
and the creator's performance history
- Scout - scores all 50 ideas and selects the top 5 with HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW ratings
- Analyst - ranks competitors by engagement, identifies winning formats and content gaps
-Planner - creates a locked 7-day content calendar with optimal post times and formats
5. Sends a Telegram report with top ideas, competitor rankings, and weekly plan
6. Updates a live dashboard (GitHub Pages) with all agent outputs, stats, and competitor
benchmarks
7. Learns over time - tracks every post, logs 48h performance data, computes what
formats/hooks/times work best for that specific creator, and feeds it back into the next day's
agents
On-demand script generation: Reply any number (1-50) or type a custom idea in Telegram -
Vercel webhook triggers GitHub Actions -+ full hook + script delivered in Telegram within 2
minutes, PC completely off.
Second Brain: Persistent long-term memory storing hook bank, competitor scripts, content log,
performance archive, topic clusters, and trend history - agents query this instead of raw data
dumps, preventing context rot.
Infrastructure: Runs 100% in the cloud (GitHub Actions + Vercel + GitHub Pages). No PC
required. Total cost: ~$0/month within free tiers.
This is the entire context of the automation and the Al agents I built and for now, for this
particular video, I want to give them this thing for free. I want to give the guide on how to build
it for free as a PDF in the comment CTA. Build me a script for this!
